
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lvwangshuOI/p/23416520" title="发布于 2026-10-23 16:53">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">P8981 「DROI」Round 1 距离 题解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="p8981-droiround-1-距离-题解"><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/P8981" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">P8981 「DROI」Round 1 距离</a> 题解</h1>
<h2 id="题意">题意</h2>
<p>给定一棵 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 个点的树，距离 <span class="math inline">\(\operatorname{dis}(u,v)\)</span> 按<strong>点数</strong>计。若点对 <span class="math inline">\((u,v)\)</span> 满足任意点 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 到 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span>、<span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 的距离都不超过 <span class="math inline">\(\operatorname{dis}(u,v)\)</span>，称之为<strong>极远点对</strong>。设经过点 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 的极远点对数为 <span class="math inline">\(v_x\)</span>，求</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\sum_{x=1}^{n} v_x^k \bmod 998244353,\qquad k \in \{1,2\},\ n \leq 5 \times 10^6\)</span></p>
<h3 id="显然极远点对--树的直径">显然：极远点对 = 树的直径</h3>
<p>于是题目等价于：<strong>对每个点 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span>，统计有多少条直径经过 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span></strong>。注意星形树中有 <span class="math inline">\(\binom{n-1}{2} = \Theta(n^2)\)</span> 条直径，所以<strong>只能计数，不能枚举</strong>。</p>
<h2 id="pre-work">Pre work</h2>
<p>以下距离均用<strong>边数</strong>，记直径边数为 <span class="math inline">\(D\)</span>。把树以 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 号点为根，需要三组信息，各由一次 DFS 完成：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>直径长 <span class="math inline">\(D\)</span>：</strong> 从 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 找最远点 <span class="math inline">\(a\)</span>，再从 <span class="math inline">\(a\)</span> 找最远点，最大距离即 <span class="math inline">\(D\)</span>。</li>
<li><strong>向下信息：</strong> <span class="math inline">\(\operatorname{dw}[u]\)</span> 表示 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 到子树内最远点的边数，<span class="math inline">\(\operatorname{dc}[u]\)</span> 为个数。后序遍历，用儿子的 <span class="math inline">\(\operatorname{dw}[v]+1\)</span> 竞争最大值、并列累加个数即可。</li>
<li><strong>向上信息：</strong> <span class="math inline">\(\operatorname{up}[u]\)</span> 表示 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 到子树外最远点的边数，<span class="math inline">\(\operatorname{uc}[u]\)</span> 为个数。自下而上的 DP 看不到子树外，必须换根：设 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 为 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 的父亲，则</li>
</ul>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\operatorname{up}[v] = 1 + \max\big(\operatorname{up}[u],\ \max_{v' \neq v}(\operatorname{dw}[v']+1),\ 0\big)\)</span></p>
<p>三个候选分别覆盖祖父方向、兄弟方向、父亲自身。实现时先在 <span class="math inline">\(u\)</span> 处求出子方向链长的最大值 <span class="math inline">\((m_1,c_1)\)</span> 与次大值 <span class="math inline">\((m_2,c_2)\)</span>，再对每个儿子按"是否为最大值的唯一来源"决定用 <span class="math inline">\(m_1\)</span> 还是 <span class="math inline">\(m_2\)</span>。个数取并列达到最大值的候选之和。</p>
<h2 id="核心对每个点-统计经过它的直径数">核心：对每个点 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span>，统计经过它的直径数</h2>
<h3 id="把经过-转成方向">把"经过 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span>"转成方向</h3>
<p>从 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 出发的每条边通向一个<strong>方向</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>儿子 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 方向：链长 <span class="math inline">\(\operatorname{dw}[v] + 1\)</span>，个数 <span class="math inline">\(\operatorname{dc}[v]\)</span>；</li>
<li>父亲方向：链长 <span class="math inline">\(\operatorname{up}[x]\)</span>，个数 <span class="math inline">\(\operatorname{uc}[x]\)</span>。</li>
</ul>
<p>关键事实：<strong>一条路径经过 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span>，当且仅当它的两个端点落在 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 的两个不同方向</strong>。若两端在同一方向，路径在子树内部就"拐弯"了，根本碰不到 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span>。</p>
<p>因此经过 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 的直径只有两种形态：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>内点形态：</strong> 两端分属不同方向 <span class="math inline">\(i, j\)</span>，且 <span class="math inline">\(d_i + d_j = D\)</span>——两段链拼起来恰好是直径；</li>
<li><strong>端点形态：</strong> <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 自己是一端，某方向链长恰为 <span class="math inline">\(D\)</span>，该方向每个最远点都与 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 构成一条直径。</li>
</ul>
<p>设 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 的全部方向为 <span class="math inline">\((d_1, c_1), (d_2, c_2), \dots\)</span>，则</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\boxed{\,v_x = \underbrace{\sum_{i&lt;j,\ d_i+d_j=D} c_i \cdot c_j}_{\text{内点形态}} + \underbrace{\sum_{i,\ d_i=D} c_i}_{\text{端点形态}}\,}\)</span></p>
<h3 id="线性计算边看边匹配">线性计算：边看边匹配</h3>
<p>朴素枚举所有方向对是 <span class="math inline">\(O(\deg^2)\)</span>，星形树的中心点会把总复杂度卡成 <span class="math inline">\(O(n^2)\)</span>。发现：处理方向 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 时，真正需要的只是<strong>之前处理过的方向中，链长恰为 <span class="math inline">\(D - d_i\)</span> 的个数之和</strong>，至于具体是哪些方向无关紧要。</p>
<p>维护按链长索引的桶 <span class="math inline">\(\operatorname{cntAt}[d]\)</span>，逐方向处理：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>先查询：</strong> <span class="math inline">\(v_x \mathrel{+} = c_i \cdot \operatorname{cntAt}[D - d_i]\)</span>；</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>端点形态：</strong> 若 <span class="math inline">\(d_i = D\)</span>，则 <span class="math inline">\(v_x \mathrel{+} = c_i\)</span>；</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>后插入：</strong> <span class="math inline">\(\operatorname{cntAt}[d_i] \mathrel{+} = c_i\)</span>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>注意：桶是全局数组，处理完 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 后<strong>按记录的已用下标逐个清零</strong>；若整体 memset，复杂度又退回 <span class="math inline">\(O(n^2)\)</span>。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>每个方向只做 <span class="math inline">\(O(1)\)</span> 次操作，单点统计 <span class="math inline">\(O(\deg)\)</span>，全树合计 <span class="math inline">\(O(\sum \deg) = O(n)\)</span></p>
<h2 id="复杂度">复杂度</h2>
<p><span class="math inline">\(O(n)\)</span></p>
<h2 id="ac-code">AC code</h2>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include &lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;

const ll MOD = 998244353;
const int N = 5e6 + 5;

ll n, k, ans;

int head[N], ver[N * 2], nxt[N * 2];
int tot;

ll dis[N];
ll dw[N], dc[N];
ll up[N], uc[N];
ll D;

void add(int x, int y) {
    ver[++ tot] = y;
    nxt[tot] = head[x];
    head[x] = tot;
}

void pre(int u, int fa, int d) {
    dis[u] = d;
    for (int i = head[u]; i; i = nxt[i]) {
        int v = ver[i];
        if (v == fa) continue;

        pre(v, u, d + 1);
    }
}

void dfs1(int u, int fa) {
    dw[u] = 0;
    dc[u] = 1;

    for (int i = head[u]; i; i = nxt[i]) {
        int v = ver[i];
        if (v == fa) continue;

        dfs1(v, u);
        ll val = dw[v] + 1;
        ll cnt = dc[v];

        if (val &gt; dw[u]) {
            dw[u] = val;
            dc[u] = cnt;
        }
        else if (val == dw[u])
            dc[u] = (dc[u] + cnt) % MOD;
    }
}

ll cntAt[N], used[N];
ll usedTop;

void dfs2(int u, int fa) {
    ll vx = 0;
    usedTop = 0;

    if (up[u] &gt;= 0) {
        if (D - up[u] &gt;= 0) {
            vx = (vx + (ll)uc[u] * cntAt[D - up[u]]) % MOD;
        }
        if (up[u] == D) {
            vx = (vx + uc[u]) % MOD;
        }
        if (cntAt[up[u]] == 0) used[usedTop ++] = up[u];
        cntAt[up[u]] = (cntAt[up[u]] + uc[u]) % MOD;
    }

    for (int i = head[u]; i; i = nxt[i]) {
        int v = ver[i];
        if (v == fa) continue;
        ll val = dw[v] + 1;
        ll cnt = dc[v];
        if (D - val &gt;= 0) {
            vx = (vx + (ll)cnt * cntAt[D - val]) % MOD;
        }
        if (val == D) {
            vx = (vx + cnt) % MOD;
        }
        if (cntAt[val] == 0) used[usedTop ++] = val;
        cntAt[val] = (cntAt[val] + cnt) % MOD;
    }

    while (usedTop &gt; 0) {
        usedTop --;
        cntAt[used[usedTop]] = 0;
    }

    if (k == 1) ans = (ans + vx) % MOD;
    else ans = (ans + vx * vx % MOD) % MOD;

    ll m1 = -1, c1 = 0, m2 = -1, c2 = 0;
    for (int i = head[u]; i; i = nxt[i]) {
        int v = ver[i];
        if (v == fa) continue;
        ll val = dw[v] + 1;
        ll cnt = dc[v];
        if (val &gt; m1) {
            m2 = m1;
            c2 = c1;
            m1 = val;
            c1 = cnt;
        }
        else if (val == m1)
            c1 = (c1 + cnt) % MOD;
        else if (val &gt; m2) {
            m2 = val;
            c2 = cnt;
        }
        else if (val == m2)
            c2 = (c2 + cnt) % MOD;
    }

    for (int i = head[u]; i; i = nxt[i]) {
        int v = ver[i];
        if (v == fa) continue;

        ll val = dw[v] + 1;
        ll sibVal, sibCnt;
        if (val != m1) {
            sibVal = m1;
            sibCnt = c1;
        }
        else if (c1 != dc[v]) {
            sibVal = m1;
            sibCnt = (c1 - dc[v] + MOD) % MOD;
        }
        else {
            sibVal = m2;
            sibCnt = c2;
        }

        ll bestVal = 0, bestCnt = 1;
        if (up[u] &gt;= 0) {
            if (up[u] &gt; bestVal) {
                bestVal = up[u];
                bestCnt = uc[u];
            }
            else if (up[u] == bestVal)
                bestCnt = (bestCnt + uc[u]) % MOD;
        }
        if (sibVal &gt;= 0) {
            if (sibVal &gt; bestVal) {
                bestVal = sibVal;
                bestCnt = sibCnt;
            }
            else if (sibVal == bestVal)
                bestCnt = (bestCnt + sibCnt) % MOD;
        }

        up[v] = bestVal + 1;
        uc[v] = bestCnt;

        dfs2(v, u);
    }
}

int main () {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    cin &gt;&gt; n &gt;&gt; k;

    tot = 0;

    for (int i = 1; i &lt; n; i ++) {
        int u, v; cin &gt;&gt; u &gt;&gt; v;

        add(u, v);
        add(v, u);
    }

    pre(1, 0, 0);

    int a = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i ++) {
        if (dis[i] &gt; dis[a]) a = i;
    }

    pre(a, 0, 0);

    D = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i &lt;= n; i ++) D = max(D, dis[i]);

    dfs1(1, 0);

    up[1] = -1;
    uc[1] = 0;
    dfs2(1, 0);

    cout &lt;&lt; ans % MOD &lt;&lt; '\n';

    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
